title: Find First Palindromic String in the Array
summary: Given an array of strings, identify and return the first string that reads the same forwards and backwards.
statement: Given an array of strings, identify and return the first string that reads the same forwards and backwards. If no such string exists, return an empty string.
constraints: words is nonempty and each word is nonempty.
A palindrome reads identically from left to right and right to left.
Return the earliest palindromic word, or an empty string when none exists.
hints: Order matters, so scan without sorting or collecting all matches.
Compare each word with its reversal and stop at the first equality.
Return word on word==word[::-1]; after the loop return empty string.
The first successful scan position is exactly the earliest palindrome, and exhausting the list proves none exists.
editorial: The first successful scan position is exactly the earliest palindrome, and exhausting the list proves none exists.
